characters.name: Teo Kesh
characters.description: 2291. Debt-bound tug pilot of the Small Mercy, hauling brine-glass from Hollin to Anchorage. Owes the Concern 41,212 marks she inherited from her parents. Wry, profane, guarded, fiercely loyal to her brother. Wears a glass bead Nico cut from his first seam.

characters.name: Nico Kesh
characters.description: 2291. Teo's younger brother, 26, a glass-cutter in Shaft Nine and an organiser of the Cutters' Union. Reckless, idealistic, funny, sure the shaft can be made to stand together.

characters.name: Ambrose Lyle
characters.description: 2291. Senior Throat-Reader at the Lectern on Anchorage Station; builder and player of the harp that listens to the Needle. 58, gentle, compromised, homesick for a daughter he has not seen in twenty years. Tunes his harp with a brass fork engraved for her.

characters.name: Hesper Vane
characters.description: 2291. Director of the Ostrander Concern's Reach Concession. 47, precise, unhurried, a believer in order and numbers who never raises her voice. Architect of the Keeping.

characters.name: Corrigan Dace
characters.description: 2291. Tug pilot of the Brannock, Teo's old lover and oldest friend. 40, tired, charming, deep in debt, father of nine-year-old Lulu.

characters.name: Lulu Dace
characters.description: 2291. Corrigan's daughter, nine. Collects bolts and swears like a pilot.

characters.name: Salome Okafor
characters.description: 2291. The shaft chaplain of Tallow, sixty-odd, ordained by nobody. Keeps the Tally, the steel plate on which Shaft Nine's dead are scratched.

characters.name: Okoro Brandt
characters.description: 2291. Marshal of Concern Security on the Reach. Large, patient, does what he is told and sleeps well.

characters.name: Bettany Shore
characters.description: 2291. Junior throat-reader at the Lectern, Ambrose's assistant. Twenty-two, ambitious, frightened.

characters.name: Juno Asante
characters.description: 2608. Lieutenant Commander in the Compact Navy, captain of the corvette Vigil. 31, dutiful, clipped, very good at her job, and the older sister of a girl the Draw has just taken.

characters.name: Pell Asante
characters.description: 2608. Juno's younger sister, 19, a painter and a believer. Drawn as a Keeper for the Thirtieth Keeping, and glad of it.

characters.name: Efua Asante
characters.description: 2608. Speaker of the Compact Assembly, mother of Juno and Pell. Leads the faction that wants peace with the Shoals.

characters.name: Adaeze Quill
characters.description: 2608. Warden-archivist of the Anchorhold, keeper of the reliquary and a trained throat-reader. 44, exact, devout, kind; the kind of believer who checks.

characters.name: Cassius Mor
characters.description: 2608. High Warden of the Throat, head of the Wardens. 66, warm-voiced, patient, sure that a civilisation is the story it tells about what happens if it stops.

characters.name: Tobiah Greaves
characters.description: 2608. Admiral of the Compact Navy's Home Squadron, Juno's commander. A hawk who has been winning the wrong war for six years.

characters.name: Rhee Calder
characters.description: 2608. Commander of the Shoals Free League fleet, once Juno's classmate at the Academy. Defected after the Twenty-Ninth Draw took his brother.

characters.name: Ezra Lind
characters.description: 2608. A Keeper drawn alongside Pell; a dock clerk from the Shoals side of Tallow, frightened and funny.

characters.name: Danny Marsh
characters.description: 2608. Juno's executive officer on the Vigil. Young, loyal, a good shot and a bad liar.

characters.name: Nan Hollis
characters.description: 2608. Chief engineer of the Vigil, fifty, has kept the ship alive through six years of war and expects no thanks.

characters.name: Mara Teague
characters.description: 2608. A former lay clerk of the Draw, defected to the Shoals; captured by the Vigil carrying a list.

characters.name: Isra Venn
characters.description: 2937. Bone-picker: pilots the salvage skiff Gristle in the Ossuary, stripping the Returns. 24, hard, sardonic, believes in nothing she cannot sell.

characters.name: Hanne Venn
characters.description: 2937. Isra's grandmother, seventies, a teller: she keeps the old songs and stories of the Reach, half of them wrong and all of them sung.

characters.name: Ostap Pike
characters.description: 2937. Isra's crewmate on the Gristle. Forties, huge, quiet, coughing out his lungs from glass-dust. Once a Lantern man.

characters.name: Lucan Aske
characters.description: 2937. A Warden of the Throat at the Anchor, 29, the last who can properly play the old harp. Doubting, careful, funny when he forgets to be holy.

characters.name: Benedek Saar
characters.description: 2937. Prior of the Wardens at the Anchor, old and tired, keeping a dozen monks alive by keeping on the right side of whoever holds Tallow.

characters.name: Mercy Oduya
characters.description: 2937. Prophet-warlord of Tallow, head of the Lantern. Fifty, sincere, magnetic; lost her son to the Fifty-Ninth Keeping and means to save the Needle with a Great Keeping.

characters.name: Deacon Rusk
characters.description: 2937. The Lamplighter's enforcer, captain of her Lantern men. Thin, polite, enjoys his work.

characters.name: Tobin Oduya
characters.description: 2937. The Lamplighter's son, who flew in the Fifty-Ninth Keeping eleven years ago, at seventeen.
